repairs.detail: Bypass the native grayscale CNN. Preserve native 500-dimensional attention and classifier. Identity when D=500, otherwise explicit learned D-to-500 ReLU projection. Binary two-class logits [0,s] preserve native sigmoid semantics; larger heads are marked adapted.

Remove only unused modules.emb_position wildcard import: the upstream tree lacks modules and none of the imported positional symbols is referenced. Actual ACMIL_MYMHA/EMA remain native; unused broken ACMIL_MHA is not selected.
Expose update_anchor for matching finite states, avoiding the upstream training-script guard that updates only NaN states. No automatic EMA update is performed during forward.

Coordinate native DimReduction, Attention_Gated, Classifier_1fc and Attention_with_Classifier with AFS/MaxS/MaxMinS distillation. Preserve pseudo-bag logits and grouping indices. Evaluation uses an explicitly recorded deterministic partition seed.
Omit eager imports of unrelated supervised/survival models; import unchanged PANTHERBase and native EM implementation directly.

Require a finite numeric .npy prototype matrix and preserve native representation/assignments. Add a separately identified linear downstream classifier; never fit prototypes implicitly from evaluation bags.
